rfc8259.observation: Inter-system JSON outside a closed ecosystem must use UTF8. Network senders must not add a BOM; receivers may ignore one. Explicit strict UTF8 decoding of external EMAIL callback bytes is consistent with this interoperability requirement and prevents byte-parser encoding autodetection from accepting UTF16/UTF32 transport bytes. This requirement does not itself prove the selected provider account schema or authorize live sending.
